title: Personal Ai Tutor
motto: Khanmigo (Khan Academy), Duolingo Max, Google LearnLM / Gemini for Education, Quizlet Q-Chat, and Synthesis Tutor all shipped adaptive multimodal tutoring at scale in 2026. The common shape is a Socratic policy (never just dump the answer), a learner model that updates after every interaction (Bayesian knowledge tracing style), voice + text + photo-math input, curriculum graph retrieval, spaced-repetition scheduling, and hard safety filters for age-appropriate content. The capstone is to ship a subject-specific tutor (K-12 algebra or intro Python), run a two-week efficacy study with 10 learners, and pass a content-safety audit.
